sources: Google Maps panel: University Forty County Park, read 2026-11-02

values.note: 8 full-hookup sites; the old note also says primitive camping at the south end, which no page read now confirms.

sites.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/Calhoun/Park/University-40 ('In 2020, an 8-spot campground with full hookups and a shower house was added'), read 2026-11-02

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/Calhoun/Park/University-40 ('two shelter houses, three vault toilets'; 'a shower house'), read 2026-11-02

note: Calhoun County Conservation Board park on forty acres along Cedar Creek just S of Lohrville. Primitive camping at the south end. ~$25 full hookup / $15 primitive, first-come, 14-day max (no county page read states these). Camp loop sits back from the creek behind a wooded buffer. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 8 full-hookup sites, showers. Added vault toilets. No county page gives a rate, season or booking rule. Pin ~200 m east of the loop; phone given.
flags: NO RATE: MyCountyParks lists only the University 40 Cabin as bookable and posts no campsite fee. The county has no conservation page I could find (calhouncountyiowa.com is the economic-development site; its attractions page says only 'University 40 Park : Quiet camping and outdoor recreation' and links to MyCountyParks). A web-search excerpt attributed '8 full hookup campsites available for $25/night' to https://www.cruisecalhoun.com/explore/university_40/ , but that URL now redirects to calhouncountyiowa.com's home page, so I couldn't read it and didn't write a fee. It agrees with the note's ~$25. Worth a call to 712-297-7131.
PHONE: entry has none. Calhoun County Conservation 712-297-7131 (MyCountyParks cabin page: 'please call 712-297-7131'). apply.py doesn't write phone.

PIN: stored 42.2518,-94.5398 is in open prairie. Imagery shows the small loop with pads at about 42.2521,-94.5421, ~200 m west: under the 250-m line but plainly not the camp, and worth moving. Google 42.2512,-94.5431 is ~120 m SW of the loop.

Waterfront: 'not waterfront' holds at the real loop. Cedar Creek's visible channel starts ~250 m SE through woods and prairie; the 'small pond' by the east edge is ~400 m away. Imagery estimates; Overpass timed out. Stored call was read at the wrong pin, though it lands the same.

FCFS and 14-day max in booking are note-derived and stay: no page read contradicts them. Google panel shows no rating for this listing. Name: county 'University 40', Google 'University Forty County Park'.
